prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in right after pet or path selection consistently won, but reordering sign-in after photo upload severely hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, photo processing/accuracy hints, and path duration hints won; account recovery hints hurt, while audio chimes, notifications, and badges showed no clear effect.
Live wait timers, split photo upload/waiting screen redesigns, and centered home control layouts won, whereas desktop launchpad/tray reference redesigns, trait selectors, and sub-flows hurt or showed no clear effect.
Personality-driven and refreshed path selection headlines won, but story copy, photo clarity guidance copy, and estimated time headlines hurt performance.
Desktop control tutorial and quick toggle guide screens won, whereas tray navigation/reference screens, tray icon control screens, and sub-flows hurt or showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, post-photo sign-in reordering, and major layout redesigns, while underestimating targeted hints, live wait timers, and select guide screens/layouts.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Interaction Shortcuts Guide Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding guide screen right before final completion that explains key shortcuts and pet toggle controls. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets after onboarding completes.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a clear split layout separating pet credentials and account confirmation details. (why: The adoption stage shows an 81.9% conversion rate with high mean duration; a cleaner layout speeds up user progression.)
2: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Layout Desktop Companion Control Guide: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a spotlight layout focusing entirely on desktop pet controls. (why: Multiple support emails mention post-onboarding confusion around controlling or hiding the pet.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Sync Guarantee Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint promising automatic restoration of existing pets upon log in. (why: The largest group of support emails (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Style Matching Hint: Provides guidance text during photo selection on how image quality directly affects pet appearance. (why: Users reported custom pet rendering issues to support after completing onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Account Safety Hint: Adds a hint under path choices explaining that chosen companion paths sync with user profile data. (why: Setting clear account persistence expectations early reduces drop-off across subsequent sign-in steps.)
6: [home, notification] Background Generation System Status Info: Configures background notification alerts and progress indicators while pet assets render. (why: Long mean waiting screen times lead to user drop-offs if users feel stuck.)
7: [sign_in, layout] Centered Card Sign-In Safety Layout: Switches the sign-in screen to a centered layout focused on account security and pet save guarantee. (why: Sign-in step drop-offs and account reset support tickets show users need strong reassurance when signing in.)

scores.note: Desktop control tutorials work well, but adding a new screen at finish has historically shown mixed results (-0.8% avg).
Adoption redesigns average -1.5% lift and major layout redesigns consistently underperform compared to predictions.
Centered control guide layouts perform well and directly target frequent post-onboarding support issues.
Addresses the largest support email category; persistence hints consistently win with config-only effort.
Photo processing and accuracy hints won in past weeks and adoption hints average +4.6% relative lift.
Path hints show modest historical success (+1.1% avg) and are quick to configure.
Home notifications average +1.5% lift and help mitigate long wait times during background generation.
Centered layouts win, but layout redesigns overall require code changes and yield smaller gains than hints.
